presets.label: Plain
presets.description: Builds a standard llama.cpp command without selecting a specialized workload or decoding strategy. It keeps the most common model, runtime, offload, cache, prompt, and listener fields in Essentials.

presets.label: Multi-GPU
presets.description: Focuses the controls used to place and split a model across multiple accelerators. It leaves split policy and ratios unset because the correct values depend on the model and available devices.

presets.label: Default Speculative
presets.description: Enables llama.cpp's current default speculative configuration through --spec-default. It exposes the n-gram-mod controls used by that default without guessing performance values.

presets.label: MTP
presets.description: Uses Multi Token Prediction heads from the main model through --spec-type draft-mtp. It focuses MTP controls without requesting a separate draft model.

presets.label: DFlash
presets.description: Uses a DFlash block-diffusion draft model through the existing DFlash model shortcut. It exposes draft model, token, GPU, cache, Flash Attention, and Jinja controls without forcing hardware-dependent defaults.

presets.label: Draft Model
presets.description: Uses a separate simple draft model through --spec-type draft-simple. It focuses both model sources and the draft probability, device, GPU, and cache controls.

presets.label: EAGLE-3
presets.description: Uses an EAGLE-3 draft model through --spec-type draft-eagle3. It focuses both model sources and the draft probability, device, GPU, and cache controls.

presets.label: N-gram
presets.description: Uses simple n-gram pattern matching through --spec-type ngram-simple. It exposes the n-gram length, draft length, and minimum-hit controls without requiring a draft model.

presets.label: Chat / API
presets.description: Focuses a standard chat-completion and HTTP API server configuration. It clears embedding and reranking workload modes but leaves optional Jinja, reasoning, templates, and experimental tools under user control.

presets.label: Embeddings
presets.description: Configures llama-server for a dedicated embeddings workload. It enables embedding-only mode while leaving pooling unset so llama.cpp can use the model default.

presets.label: Reranking
presets.description: Configures llama-server for the reranking endpoint with embedding mode and rank pooling. It exposes the model, batch, parallel, listener, alias, and authentication controls needed around that semantic requirement.

flags.description: Draft model CPU affinity mask Complements cpu-range-draft. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft CPU strict batch
flags.description: Uses strict CPU placement for draft model. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft priority batch
flags.description: Sets draft process/thread priority : 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft poll batch
flags.description: Uses polling to wait for draft model work. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft override tensor
flags.description: Override tensor buffer type for draft model. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft CPU MoE
flags.description: Keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU for the draft model. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft MoE CPU layers
flags.description: Keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU for the draft model. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft tokens max
flags.description: Sets the number of tokens to draft for speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft tokens min
flags.description: Minimum number of draft tokens to use for speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft split probability
flags.description: Speculative decoding split probability. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft minimum probability
flags.description: Minimum speculative decoding probability (greedy). Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Spec draft backend sampling
flags.description: Offload draft sampling to the backend. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft device list
flags.description: Comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading the draft model (none = don't offload). Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft GPU layers
flags.description: Max number of draft model layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all'. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Draft model path
flags.description: Draft model for speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Spec type
flags.description: Comma-separated list of types of speculative decoding to use. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram mod min
flags.description: Minimum number of ngram tokens to use for ngram-based speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram mod max
flags.description: Maximum number of ngram tokens to use for ngram-based speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram mod match
flags.description: Ngram-mod lookup length. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram simple size N
flags.description: Ngram size N for ngram-simple speculative decoding, length of lookup n-gram. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram simple size M
flags.description: Ngram size M for ngram-simple speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram simple min hits
flags.description: Minimum hits for ngram-simple speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram map-k size N
flags.description: Ngram size N for ngram-map-k speculative decoding, length of lookup n-gram. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram map-k size M
flags.description: Ngram size M for ngram-map-k speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram map-k min hits
flags.description: Minimum hits for ngram-map-k speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram map-k4v size N
flags.description: Ngram size N for ngram-map-k4v speculative decoding, length of lookup n-gram. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram map-k4v size M
flags.description: Ngram size M for ngram-map-k4v speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Ngram map-k4v min hits
flags.description: Minimum hits for ngram-map-k4v speculative decoding. Tune it only when speculative decoding is enabled and the draft strategy requires an explicit override.

flags.label: Gpt Oss 20b default
flags.description: Uses gpt-oss-20b (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Gpt Oss 120b default
flags.description: Uses gpt-oss-120b (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Vision Gemma 4b default
flags.description: Uses Gemma 3 4B QAT (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Vision Gemma 12b default
flags.description: Uses Gemma 3 12B QAT (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Default speculative config
flags.description: Enables default speculative decoding config. This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Static lookup cache
flags.description: Sets the path to static lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (not updated by generation). Use it when tuning model loading, cache use, or memory pressure for the target system.

flags.label: Dynamic lookup cache
flags.description: Sets the path to dynamic lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (updated by generation). Use it when tuning model loading, cache use, or memory pressure for the target system.

flags.label: Checkpoint min step
flags.description: Minimum spacing between context checkpoints in tokens. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: KV unified
flags.description: Uses single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Cache idle slots
flags.description: Save idle slots to the prompt cache on new task, and clear them when using unified KV. Use it when tuning model loading, cache use, or memory pressure for the target system.

flags.label: SPM infill
flags.description: Uses Suffix/Prefix/Middle pattern for infill (instead of Prefix/Suffix/Middle) as some models prefer this. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Pooling
flags.description: Pooling type for embeddings, use model default if unspecified. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Cont batching
flags.description: Controls whether to enable continuous batching (aka dynamic batching). Leave it unset to keep the upstream runtime default, or set it when the workload needs an explicit override.

flags.label: Mtmd batch max tokens
flags.description: Maximum number of image tokens per batch when encoding images. Use it only with models and endpoints that support the corresponding media or audio capability.

flags.label: Server alias
flags.description: Sets model name aliases, comma-separated (to be used by API). Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Server tags
flags.description: Sets model tags, comma-separated (informational, not used for routing). Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Embedding normalize
flags.description: Normalisation for embeddings (-1=none, 0=max absolute int16, 1=taxicab, 2=euclidean, >2=p-norm). Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Host
flags.description: Ip address to listen, or bind to an UNIX socket if the address ends with sock. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Port
flags.description: Controls port for llama.cpp. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Reuse port
flags.description: Allow multiple sockets to bind to the same port. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Static path
flags.description: Sets the path to serve static files from. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: API prefix
flags.description: Prefix path the server serves from, without the trailing slash. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: UI config JSON
flags.description: JSON that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults). Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: UI config file
flags.description: JSON file that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults). Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Web UI MCP proxy
flags.description: Controls the experimental MCP CORS proxy exposed through the server Web UI. Do not enable it when untrusted users can reach the server because it expands browser-accessible capabilities.

flags.label: Built-in tools
flags.description: Experimental: whether to enable built-in tools for AI agents - do not enable in untrusted environments. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Server agent mode
flags.description: Enables the experimental server agent bundle, including the CORS proxy and built-in tools. Use it only in trusted environments because enabled tools can access local resources.

flags.label: Web UI
flags.description: Controls whether to enable the Web UI. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Embeddings only
flags.description: Restrict to only support embedding use case; use only with dedicated embedding models. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Reranking endpoint
flags.description: Enables reranking endpoint on server. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: API key
flags.description: API key to use for authentication, multiple keys can be provided as a comma-separated list. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: API key file
flags.description: Sets the path to file containing API keys, one per line; lines starting with a hash are treated as comments. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: SSL key file
flags.description: Sets the path to file a PEM-encoded SSL private key. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: SSL cert file
flags.description: Sets the path to file a PEM-encoded SSL certificate. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Timeout seconds
flags.description: Server read/write timeout in seconds. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: SSE ping interval
flags.description: Sets the interval in seconds between server-sent event ping messages. Use it to keep streaming connections alive through proxies that close quiet connections.

flags.label: HTTP threads
flags.description: Sets the number of threads used to process HTTP requests. Leave it unset to keep the upstream runtime default, or set it when the workload needs an explicit override.

flags.label: Cache prompt
flags.description: Controls whether to enable prompt caching. Use it when tuning model loading, cache use, or memory pressure for the target system.

flags.label: Cache reuse chunk
flags.description: Min chunk size to attempt reusing from the cache via KV shifting, requires prompt caching to be enabled. Use it when tuning model loading, cache use, or memory pressure for the target system.

flags.label: Metrics endpoint
flags.description: Enables prometheus compatible metrics endpoint. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Props endpoint
flags.description: Enables changing global properties via POST /props. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Slots
flags.description: Expose slots monitoring endpoint. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Slot save path
flags.description: Sets the path to save slot kv cache. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Media path
flags.description: Directory for loading local media files; files can be accessed via file:// URLs using relative paths. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Router models dir
flags.description: Directory containing models for the router server. Use it when selecting or configuring the model source for this command.

flags.label: Router models preset
flags.description: Sets the path to INI file containing model presets for the router server. Use it when selecting or configuring the model source for this command.

flags.label: Router models max
flags.description: For router server, maximum number of models to load simultaneously. Use it when selecting or configuring the model source for this command.

flags.label: Models autoload
flags.description: For router server, whether to automatically load models. Use it when selecting or configuring the model source for this command.

flags.label: Prefill assistant
flags.description: Controls whether to prefill the assistant's response if the last message is an assistant message. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Slot prompt similarity
flags.description: Sets the prompt-similarity threshold used when selecting a reusable server slot. Tune it when prompt-cache reuse is either too eager or too conservative for the workload.

flags.label: LoRA init without apply
flags.description: Load LoRA adapters without applying them (apply later via POST /lora-adapters). Use it when applying an adapter or control vector to the loaded model.

flags.label: Sleep idle seconds
flags.description: Sets the number of seconds of idleness after which the server will sleep. Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Vocoder model
flags.description: Loads a vocoder model for supported server audio-generation workflows. Set this only when the selected model and endpoint produce audio tokens that require vocoding.

flags.label: TTS use guide tokens
flags.description: Uses guide tokens to improve TTS word recall. Use it only with models and endpoints that support the corresponding media or audio capability.

flags.label: Embd Gemma default
flags.description: Uses default EmbeddingGemma model (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Fim Qwen 1 5b default
flags.description: Uses default Qwen 25 Coder 15B (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Fim Qwen 3b default
flags.description: Uses default Qwen 25 Coder 3B (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Fim Qwen 7b default
flags.description: Uses default Qwen 25 Coder 7B (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

flags.label: Fim Qwen 7b spec
flags.description: Uses Qwen 25 Coder 7B + 05B draft for speculative decoding (note: can download weights from the internet). Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Fim Qwen 14b spec
flags.description: Uses Qwen 25 Coder 14B + 05B draft for speculative decoding (note: can download weights from the internet). Use it to configure the long-running HTTP server or one of its exposed capabilities.

flags.label: Fim Qwen 30b default
flags.description: Uses default Qwen 3 Coder 30B A3B Instruct (note: can download weights from the internet). This action or preset is intended for deliberate one-command setup or inspection.

fields.label: Server executable
fields.description: Sets the path to the llama-server executable. Leave it empty to use the default path for the selected operating system.

fields.label: CLI executable
fields.description: Sets the path to the llama-cli executable. Leave it empty to use the default path for the selected operating system.

fields.label: DFlash model path
fields.description: Selects a DFlash draft GGUF with -md and automatically sets --spec-type draft-dflash. It overrides the generic Draft model path and Spec type fields so the command never emits duplicates.

fields.label: Extra flags appended verbatim
fields.description: Appends non-empty lines exactly as written after all registered options. Raw text is not validated or translated between shell families, so verify it after switching operating systems.
